name: Iron for Bread

scenario.name: Iron for Bread
scenario.briefing: Clan Whaleroad trades bread for Forge iron and marches with you against the Kettleborn Raiders. Keep the clan in the field; it will not stay true for ever.

objectives.text: Keep Clan Whaleroad in the field.
Break the Kettleborn Raiders and Clan Whaleroad.

betrayal.text: Whaleroad remembers who was cold first.
